mechanism.mechanism_of_action: Third-generation EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor that irreversibly binds to mutant EGFR (including T790M, L858R, exon 19 deletions), blocking signal transduction and inducing tumor cell apoptosis

clinical.indications: Locally advanced or metastatic EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), including first-line treatment, adjuvant therapy, and in combination with chemotherapy for advanced disease

market.market_position: Leading EGFR inhibitor for NSCLC, blockbuster status [uncertain]
